title: Capricor Therapeutics DMD Drug Approval Delayed, Q3 Results Published
digest:
Capricor Therapeutics' DMD drug Deramiocel had its FDA approval deadline extended to November 22 from August 22, with the company reporting Q3 financial results on November 10 and updating investors accordingly.

The delay follows an earlier PDUFA date of August 22, now rescheduled without further explanation. The Q3 results included revenue of $1.2 million and a net loss of $6.8 million, though specific details on the approval timeline's impact remain unaddressed in the current disclosures.

Seeking Alpha (2026-11-13) provided the primary update on the approval extension, while the financial details originated from the company's November 10 investor report.
